item.title: August 19, 2026 - First things first
item.description: Page 241. "We apply effort to our most obvious problems and let go of the rest. We do the job at hand and, as we progress, new opportunities for improvement present themselves." Just for Today: I will walk the path of my recovery by taking the step right in front of me.
